notes.title: Whiplash Patch Level 9000 Hotfix 1.1337
notes.content:
Fixed the Achievements so they now actually work! + Included a couple of new ones.

Removed unnecessary textures from the game.

Postprocess and effect settings in Menu settings is turned off at default for faster load times and higher FPS.

Fixed the Physics-assets on all pedestrians so they don't flop around when in ragdoll and consuming CPU-power.

A couple of small secrets at the starting Area :)

Totally SKYNET CONFIRMED.

notes.title: New Patch Level 9000 is out!
notes.content:
Fellow Dummys!

We just released a new patch!

We've fixed alot of issues, and have done alot of Optimizations too make it run better on lower spec machines. We have also added ALOT of new content, new stuntramps, loops, obstacles, slides, Trampolines and much much more! Now it is truly a Crash Valley!

Full patch notes:


The game now takes 1Gb less GPU-RAM than before.

Lowered Game filesize from 4.3Gb to 2.8Gb

25% better framerates than before, with an additional 25-30% if you disable PostProcess in the Settings menu.

Cull Distance optimizations

All resolutions now work as intended, no texture flickering on non screen-native resolutions anymore! :)

Game load up time is now 3x faster than before.

You no longer loose XX FPS after a while like before, you now keep the same fps the entire play session.

Random Fix, i don't know what but it's something. Ahh now I remember! Shit, I forgot again...

Collision detection is greatly improved on meshes, the weapons and on the Dummy himself.

AFK, got to go outside, I heard it's nice out there.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27042209/2454db2850bf600d4ff8810341b122a1d8518e98.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Whiplash Patch Update 1.1
notes.content:
Fixed:

 - Reduced the game filesize by 40%, resulting in faster loading times and lower RAM-usage.

 - Better framerates, especially when you are up in the sky and looking down.

 - Exiting vehicles now work as intended. The crash test dummy now spawns  at the same location as your vehicle.

 - All vehicles can now run down innocent people in Crash Valley without getting stopped infront of them.

 - Rocket boots now activates and set you into ragdoll when you press F, instead of pressing R and then F.

 - Every hat in the Hatstore is now equippable.

Added:

 - You can now customize your Dummy with different colors! Go check it out in the Crash Shop 1.6

 - Catapult Chair in all vehicles! You can now throw yourself out of the vehicle and fly up in the air, land on a couple of civilians and stand up  like nothing happened :).

 - More stuntramps, loops, rocket-sofas and objects around Crash Valley.

 - NEW SECRET AREA! Make sure to bring a vehicle and have a laugh all the way to the ground :).

 - NEW VEHICLE! You can now drive the Ambulance located by the skyscraper, perfect piece for the secret area I told you about. Be quiet about it though, since it's a secret.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27042209/e6c692e760e9ab883203f6b4f4ee6e9820736a34.jpg[/img]
